info.text:
Spotify doesn't pay artists per stream. At all.
It pays by streamshare: roughly two-thirds of every music dollar goes to rights holders, split by share of all streams.
Spotify pays labels and publishers, who pay artists under their contracts.
Since April 2024, a track needs 1,000 streams in 12 months to earn royalties.
Spotify paid the music industry more than $11 billion in 2025.
Sources: Spotify Loud & Clear 2026, Spotify for Artists, Spotify 2025 Form 20-F.
News and education, not financial advice.
Follow @financeprostv for money explained simply.
